summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its quarterly earnings press release for the period ended March 31, 2026, and declaring a $0.80 per share quarterly dividend. The filing also discloses an open-market share repurchase program (480,460 shares, ~6.8% of outstanding, $11.36M) and the formation of a joint venture for a vessel where NRP Investors will acquire a 49% stake for ~$12.2M. These are routine reporting and capital-allocation activities, not a transformative special situation. No M&A, activist event, or strategic review is announced.
